note: The assistant's eval set (ASSISTANT_PLAN A2 subset; A8 completes it). Each case: who asks, on which page, the message, and what a good turn does. tools_all: every one called; tools_any: at least one; tools_none: none called; says: a pattern the answer must contain; not_pending: no write waits; sourced: the answer names sources; turns: more messages in the same conversation, the last one checked; status: ok | pending; pending: the write it waits on; refuse: the answer says it cannot do this and calls no write; not_said: text that must not appear. Every number in an answer must be found in what the tools returned (grounding). gate: what readiness needs (ADR-0034).
